items.title: Eight in 10 prime London homes sell below asking price, Coutts reveals
items.summary: Research from private bank Coutts shows that property values in prime central London dropped 5% in the third quarter of 2026.

items.title: High street slot machine venues could bypass budget tax rise via bingo licences
items.summary: Hundreds of adult gaming centres in England may evade recent business rates and duty changes by maintaining bingo licences.
